ex.en: The old coin is made of nickel and has worn smooth.
ex.zh: 这枚旧硬币由镍制成，已经磨损得光滑了。

words.note: 镍的化学符号是 Ni；美语中 nickel 也指五分硬币。

ex.en: She has been a generous patron of the arts for thirty years.
ex.zh: 三十年来她一直是慷慨的艺术赞助人。

words.note: patron 资助文艺事业或指常客；patron saint 是守护圣徒。

ex.en: Taking the job would entail moving to another city.
ex.zh: 接受这份工作意味着要搬到另一个城市。

words.note: entail 后接名词或动名词，表“必然带来、需要”。

ex.en: Their new model is clearly inferior to the one we bought.
ex.zh: 他们的新型号明显不如我们买的那个。

words.note: inferior to 表比较，本身已含“更差”，不加 more。

ex.en: She applied for the scholarship three weeks before the deadline.
ex.zh: 她在截止日期前三周申请了奖学金。

words.note: apply for 申请具体事物；apply to 适用于或向某处申请。

ex.en: Wartime posters were used as propaganda to encourage saving.
ex.zh: 战时海报被用作鼓励储蓄的宣传工具。

words.note: propaganda 含贬义，常指片面或虚假的宣传。

ex.en: The editor overlooked a spelling mistake on the front page.
ex.zh: 编辑漏掉了头版的一个拼写错误。

words.note: overlook 既指俯瞰，也指忽略、未注意到，注意别只用前者。

ex.en: The family took refuge in a church during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中一家人到教堂里避难。

words.note: refuge 指避难所；seek/take refuge 后常接 from 或 in。

ex.en: There has been a dramatic rise in online shopping this year.
ex.zh: 今年网络购物出现大幅增长。

words.note: dramatic 常指变化幅度大得惊人，不限于“戏剧”。

ex.en: It is incredible how quickly the children learned the new song.
ex.zh: 孩子们学新歌的速度快得令人难以置信。

words.note: in（不）+cred（相信）+ible → 难以置信的，也可表“极好的”。

ex.en: No one can say with certainty what caused the accident.
ex.zh: 没人能确定事故的原因。

words.note: certainty 是 certain 的名词；with certainty 表“确知”。

ex.en: Salt water will corrode the metal frame within a few years.
ex.zh: 海水会在几年内腐蚀这个金属框架。

words.note: corrode 指化学腐蚀；erode 多指风雨、水流侵蚀。

ex.en: He injured his spine in a fall and could not walk for months.
ex.zh: 他摔伤脊椎，几个月不能走路。

words.note: spine 指脊柱，也指书脊、刺；形容词是 spinal。

ex.en: The teacher commended her for helping a classmate during the exam.
ex.zh: 老师表扬她在考试中帮助同学。

words.note: commend sb for sth 因某事表扬；recommend 是“推荐”。

ex.en: The disease is spread by a parasite that lives in dirty water.
ex.zh: 这种疾病由一种生活在脏水中的寄生虫传播。

words.note: para（旁边）+site（食物）→ 白吃白住者；喻指依赖他人的人。

ex.en: The plants grow well under artificial light in the basement.
ex.zh: 这些植物在地下室的人造光下长得很好。

words.note: artificial 与 natural 相对，也指态度矫揉造作。

ex.en: Vitamin D deficiency is common among people who stay indoors.
ex.zh: 维生素D缺乏在常待室内的人中很常见。

words.note: de（不）+fic（做）+iency → 不足；形容词 deficient。

ex.en: As a child, she invented an imaginary friend to talk to.
ex.zh: 小时候，她虚构了一个想象中的朋友来聊天。

words.note: imaginary 只存在于想象中；imaginative 是“有想象力的”。

ex.en: The scientist wrote the formula on the board for the students.
ex.zh: 科学家把公式写在黑板上给学生看。

words.note: formula 复数常用 formulas 或 formulae；也指配方、方案。

ex.en: She looked at the dirty kitchen in disgust and left at once.
ex.zh: 她厌恶地看了看脏乱的厨房，立刻离开了。

words.note: in disgust 表状态，to one's disgust 表令人反感的事实。

ex.en: Great music can transcend language and reach people everywhere.
ex.zh: 伟大的音乐能超越语言，打动各地的人。

words.note: trans（越过）+scend（爬）→ 超越，多接抽象名词。

ex.en: The concert was a tribute to the singer who died last year.
ex.zh: 这场音乐会是在向去年去世的歌手致敬。

words.note: pay tribute to 后接人；tribute 也指贡品。

ex.en: An angry mob gathered outside the court after the verdict.
ex.zh: 判决后，一群愤怒的人聚集在法院外。

words.note: mob 含贬义，指无秩序的暴民；crowd 是中性词。

ex.en: A good manager listens to the views of his subordinates.
ex.zh: 好的管理者会听取下属的意见。

words.note: sub（在下）+ordin（顺序）→ 下级的；作动词重音在末。

ex.en: There is a growing trend toward working from home.
ex.zh: 在家工作的趋势正在增强。

words.note: trend 后接 toward 或 of；set the trend 是引领潮流。

ex.en: Finishing the marathon gave him a great sense of achievement.
ex.zh: 跑完马拉松让他有很强的成就感。

words.note: achieve 加 -ment 构成；sense of achievement 常考。

ex.en: You need sturdy shoes for walking in these rocky hills.
ex.zh: 在这些多石的山里走路需要结实的鞋。

words.note: sturdy 指结构结实，也可形容人身体强壮、立场坚定。

ex.en: A quiet street near the school makes the flat highly desirable.
ex.zh: 靠近学校的安静街道使这套公寓非常抢手。

words.note: desirable 指“值得拥有的”；desirous 是“渴望的”。

ex.en: The committee consists of eight members from different departments.
ex.zh: 委员会由来自不同部门的八名成员组成。

words.note: consist 是不及物动词，无被动语态，须接 of 或 in。

ex.en: We need reliable data before we can make a decision.
ex.zh: 在做出决定之前我们需要可靠的数据。

words.note: rely（依赖）+able → 可依赖的；反义词 unreliable。
